Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vinod - 33 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Karan - 61 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
3. Anjali - 26 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Shalini - 30 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez
5. Suresh - 32 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vinod stands in the living room. Karan and Anjali stand near him.]

Anjali: "Uncle, what's the plan today?"

[Vinod sips red wine.]

Vinod: "Let's see."

[Vinod staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Anjali: "Really?"

[Vinod dies in the fire.]

Anjali: "No… this cannot be!"
